```{r cip_code}
uni <- c('FAMU', "FAU", "FIU", "FGCU","FPU","FSU", "UCF", "UF", "UNF", "USF", "UWF")
cip_code <- c('11.0101','11.0101','11.0101','11.0101', "11.0701", '11.0101', '11.0101','11.0101','11.0701','11.0101','11.0701')
structural_comp <- c(192,217,201,204,166,188,217,190,148,232,174)
blocking_f <- c(68,81,73,78,48,70,86,66,52,109,64)
delay_f <- c(124,136,128,126,118,118,131,124,96,123,110)

uni_sum <- data.frame(uni, cip_code, structural_comp, blocking_f, delay_f)

#ggplot(data = uni_sum, aes(x=structural_comp)) + geom_boxplot(fill = 'skyblue') + labs(x = 'Structural Complexity')

ggplot(data = uni_sum, aes(x = reorder(uni, -structural_comp), y = structural_comp)) + geom_col(color = 'royalblue', fill = 'skyblue') + labs(x = 'Institution', y = 'Structural Complexity', title = 'Cumulative Structural Complexity of Courses by Institution')

ggplot(data = uni_sum, aes(x = reorder(uni, -blocking_f), y = blocking_f)) + geom_col(color = 'royalblue', fill = 'skyblue') + labs(x = 'Institution', y = 'Blocking Factor', title = 'Cumulative Blocking Factor of Courses by Institution')

ggplot(data = uni_sum, aes(x = reorder(uni, -delay_f), y = delay_f)) + geom_col(color = 'royalblue', fill = 'skyblue') + labs(x = 'Institution', y = 'Delay Factor', title = 'Cumulative Delay Factor of Courses by Institution')

#ggplot(data = uni_sum, aes(x=blocking_f)) + geom_boxplot(fill = 'skyblue') + labs(x = 'Blocking Factor')

#ggplot(data = uni_sum, aes(x=delay_f)) + geom_boxplot(fill = 'skyblue') + labs(x = 'Delay Factor')

```

```{r load_unis}
df_list <- list(famu, fau,fgcu,fpu, fiu, fsu, ucf, uf, unf, usf, uwf)
#merge all data frames in list
all_unis <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, all=TRUE), df_list)
```

```{r largest_complexities}
# cumulative most delay, blocking, centrality, complexity
max_delay <- data.frame()
max_delay <- rbind(top_n(all_unis, 5, Delay), max_delay)

max_blocking <- data.frame()
max_blocking <- rbind(top_n(all_unis, 5, Blocking), max_blocking)

max_centrality <- data.frame()
max_centrality <- rbind(top_n(all_unis, 5, Centrality), max_centrality)

max_complexity <- data.frame()
max_complexity <- rbind(top_n(all_unis, 5, Complexity), max_complexity)

uni_max_delay <- data.frame()
uni_max_blocking <- data.frame()
uni_max_centrality <- data.frame()
uni_max_complexity <- data.frame()

# TO do: Find max in each institution - on an institutional basis we see similar trends
for(df in df_list)
{
  uni_max_delay <- rbind(top_n(df, 1, Delay), uni_max_delay)
  uni_max_blocking <- rbind(top_n(df, 1, Blocking), uni_max_blocking)
  uni_max_centrality <- rbind(top_n(df, 1, Centrality), uni_max_centrality)
  uni_max_complexity <- rbind(top_n(df, 1, Complexity), uni_max_complexity)
}  

```

```{r visual}
no_gen_ed_or_elective <- all_unis %>% filter(Complexity!=1)

# all courses barring electives or gen eds (NEED TO HAVE COMPLEXITY OF MORE THAN 1 )
# to do - change x-axis scale
ggplot(no_gen_ed_or_elective, aes(x=Complexity)) + geom_bar(fill = 'skyblue',color='royalblue') + theme_bw() + labs(x = 'Course Complexity', y = 'Frequency', title = 'Distribution of Course Complexity') + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(no_gen_ed_or_elective$Complexity + 5), by = 5)) 

ggplot(no_gen_ed_or_elective, aes(x=Delay)) + geom_bar(fill = 'skyblue',color='royalblue') + theme_bw() + labs(x = 'Delay Factor', y = 'Frequency', title = 'Distribution of Delay Factor')

ggplot(no_gen_ed_or_elective, aes(x=Blocking)) + geom_bar(fill = 'skyblue',color='royalblue') + theme_bw() + labs(x = 'Blocking Factor', y = 'Frequency', title = 'Distribution of Blocking Factor')

ggplot(no_gen_ed_or_elective, aes(x=Centrality)) + geom_bar(fill = 'skyblue',color='royalblue') + theme_bw() + labs(x = 'Centrality', y = 'Frequency', title = 'Distribution of Course Centrality')

```

```{r anova_overall}
no_gen_ed_or_elective <- all_unis %>% filter(Blocking!=0)

# compare complexity (combination of blocking and delay)
complexity_aov <- aov(no_gen_ed_or_elective$Complexity ~ no_gen_ed_or_elective$uni)
summary(complexity_aov)

ggplot(no_gen_ed_or_elective, aes(x = uni, y = Complexity)) + stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point") + stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_normal, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2) + labs(x = 'Universities', title = 'Curricular Complexity by University')
```
